summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc., a Vancouver-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change of corporate name to Aetherion Technologies Inc. effective October 14, 2026, effected via Certificate and Articles of Amendment under Alberta's Business Corporations Act. Common shares are expected to trade under ticker AETR on the TSX and Nasdaq on or about October 23, 2026, pending final exchange approvals, until which WPRT continues. CUSIP/ISIN will change. The filing also gives a Canadian NI 51-102 notice of change in corporate structure. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply; watch only the ticker/CUSIP transition mechanics.
